what: Celsius makes energy drinks positioned as fitness products rather than conventional energy drinks, distributed in America by PepsiCo, and it bought the Alani Nu brand in 2025.
customers: Younger and more health-conscious energy drink buyers, through supermarkets, convenience stores and gyms.
money: Celsius and Alani Nu sold through the PepsiCo network
moat: The PepsiCo distribution agreement puts it in every cooler in America, which is the thing a drinks brand cannot build on its own, and Alani Nu adds a second fast-growing brand.
risks: Growth slowed sharply in 2024 when PepsiCo cut its inventory, which exposed how much revenue depended on shipments rather than sales
35 times earnings for a business in a crowded category
Monster and Red Bull both have far greater scale
opportunities: Revenue grew from $314M to $2.5B in four years and is $3.2B over the last twelve months
Analysts see about 35% upside, with 22 covering the stock
Alani Nu is growing faster than Celsius itself and reaches a different buyer
watch: Retail scanner sales rather than shipments, and international expansion.
